style_suggestion.reasoning: The site describes 'timeless elegance', a historic orchard warehouse and 'modern design meets rustic charm'. Rules: historic / timeless / elegance → Classic; rustic → Rustic; modern → Modern. The old Description's 'bright open layout' (Modern only) isn't the site's wording. The corrected Description says 'historic' (Classic); add 'rustic charm' to it if the team wants Rustic picked up by the rules.
